newsitem.title: UK: BFI down 12 as Panamaxes weaken further.
newsitem.headline: BFI down 12 as Panamaxes weaken further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down 12 at 1,341 points on Wednesday with brokers reporting continuing difficulties for Panamaxes in maintaining previously fixed rates.

A significantly lower level for 54,0000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for mid-Aug was reported for account of Far Eastern charterers (possibly Halla) at approximately $22.35/$22.50 no combo on Tai Chang.

In the east HMM fixed the 1990-built Oceanic Explorer 68,849 dwt delivery prompt Taiwan for a Newcastle coal round voyage at a much weaker $9,100 daily but brokers explained that this vessel was positioning for delivery on period timecharter which would have accounted in part for the lower rate.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to 19 points higher and turnover was 57 lots.
